summary.text: John Atkins is the Republican candidate for Delaware House of Representatives District 41 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democrat Ryan Stuckey in a race with no incumbent.
He previously represented District 41 in the House from 2009 to 2015.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists John Atkins's profession as owner of Blue Hen Disposal.

He served in the Delaware House of Representatives from 2009 to 2015, chairing the Agriculture Committee in the 2011-2012 and 2013-2014 sessions and also serving on the Natural Resources and Veterans Affairs committees.
Atkins won the Republican primary for District 41 on September 15, 2026, receiving 1,546 votes (48.7%) to 1,479 for Doug Conaway and 149 for Jacki Slonin.
